title: Kramskoy paints Yaroshenko
content: Left: Nikolai Yaroshenko by Ivan Kramskoy. Right: Kramskoy by YaroshenkoAfterthe last postabout the watercolor portrait of Kramskoy by Yaroshenko, I suspected that Kramskoy must have been painting Yaroshenko in return. The giveaway was the pad of paper in his lap.And sure enough, I found the other painting: Yaroshenko by Kramskoy (left). The two artists spent the summer of 1874 together in Kramskoy's country house near Siversky Station. (Link for more info)Previously:Controlled Watercolor Portrait
